tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Page ground. Dark: the brochures' near-black green field (sampled #1B211E). Light: bone, the plate the logo sits on. Carries ink, ink-muted, brass, crimson-on-dark, success, warn.

tokens.name: field-deep
tokens.usage: Recessed bands: footer, trust bar, form inputs on dark. Carries ink, ink-muted, brass, crimson-on-dark, success, warn.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Raised panels and cards (the brochures' at-a-glance and rate cells, sampled #252E29). Carries ink, ink-muted, brass, crimson-on-dark, success, warn.

tokens.name: panel-raised
tokens.usage: Panel on a panel: hover state, the highlighted hunting-days row in ItineraryTimeline, open menus. Carries ink, ink-muted, brass, crimson-on-dark, success, warn.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on field, field-deep, panel and panel-raised (both themes, 9:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: scientific names, metadata, helper text, footer links. On field, field-deep, panel and panel-raised (both themes, 5.5:1 or better).

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: Brass: eyebrows, labels, data values, active nav underline, icons that carry meaning. As text on field, field-deep, panel and panel-raised. Dark value is the brochures' sampled brass; light value is darkened so it reads as text on bone (brochure brass #C9A45C is only 2.1:1 on bone).

tokens.name: brass-rule
tokens.usage: Brass hairlines: the 1px rules under headings, the top edge of glance cells and rate cards, the elevation scale ticks. Decorative and structural only, never text. At least 3:1 on every ground in both themes.

tokens.name: brass-bright
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring colour (2px solid, 2px offset) and the selected state of checkbox chips. At least 5:1 on every ground in both themes.

tokens.name: crimson
tokens.usage: Logo crimson (exact, from the horn tips). Fill only: primary button, the active hunting-days marker, the Not included header rule. Rationed: one primary action per view. Never text on dark grounds (2.7:1 on field); use crimson-on-dark for that.

tokens.name: crimson-hover
tokens.usage: Pressed and hover fill of the primary button. on-crimson reads 7.5:1 on it.

tokens.name: on-crimson
tokens.usage: Label and icon on a crimson or crimson-hover fill (6.2:1 and 7.5:1).

tokens.name: crimson-on-dark
tokens.usage: Crimson as text or a mark: the Not included label, error messages, required-field asterisk, danger status. Lighter crimson on dark grounds (crimson itself fails as text there); in light it is the logo crimson. On field, field-deep, panel and panel-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Quiet dividers between rows (inclusions, rate rows, footer columns). Decorative only; never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Form control borders and checkbox outlines. At least 3:1 on field, field-deep, panel and panel-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: plate
tokens.usage: The bone plate behind the logo, the same in both themes, because the logo master is dark-on-light. Also the cover's logo plate.

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: Logo graphite (exact, the HVS monogram). Reference only: do not use for text or UI.

tokens.name: brand-field
tokens.usage: The brand's field green fixed in both themes: photo scrims under hero text, the cover slab. Text on it is plate.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success and Included: a blue-teal kept off the red-green axis so it never relies on hue against crimson-on-dark. Always paired with a check icon and a word. Text on field, field-deep, panel and panel-raised.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Caution notes (permit-fee note, weather advisories). Always with an icon and the word Note or Please note. Text on field, field-deep, panel and panel-raised.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and Not included: an alias of crimson-on-dark. Always with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: The floating NavBar's translucent fill over content (with backdrop blur). The only translucent surface. Under prefers-reduced-transparency use field.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dark overlay band on photographs so plate text reads (brochure title band). Same in both themes: text over photos is always plate.

families.display: "Libre Caslon Display", "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", Georgia, serif
families.sans: "Public Sans", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
families.ui: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Libre Caslon Display, one weight (400). Only at 32px and up: its hairlines thin out below that.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero title, one per page. Mobile 44px/48px.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page title of hunt and content pages. Mobile 36px/42px.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section headings, always under an eyebrow. Mobile 30px/36px.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Public Sans for everything below 32px. Tabular figures for data.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card titles, sub-sections, form group titles.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a heading or a data value, in brass.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Government licensed in Gilgit, Pakistan, since 1989.
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a page or section heading.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Travel to the community-controlled hunting area.
styles.usage: All running text. Never smaller on the web.

styles.name: body-small
styles.usage: Inclusion lists, table cells, footer, helper text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Image captions, legal line, scale labels. Never for anything a hunter must act on.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Spec values in AtAGlance and HuntCard; set font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

styles.name: data-lg
styles.usage: Large figures in TrustBar and the profile stats (1989 · No. 2087 · 3 ranges); tabular-nums.

styles.name: scientific
styles.usage: Scientific names, always italic, in ink-muted.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, eyebrow-to-value gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips, between stacked label and input.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between list rows; button vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter; panel padding on mobile; grid gap inside glance.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel and card padding; desktop grid gutter; button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between a heading block and its content.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between components inside a section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Hero top padding under the floating nav on desktop.

radius.note: Near-square, like the brochure panels. No pills except dots.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Full-bleed bands, photographs, the trust bar.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, glance cells, rate cards: the brochures' near-square panels.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, checkbox chips, the nav bar and logo plate. Square-shouldered, not pill: pills read as consumer app and fight the brochures' rectangles.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Itinerary day markers and elevation-band end caps only.

layout.note: Widths and sizes. Plain CSS values.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Max width of page content; 12-column grid inside.

tokens.name: text-max
tokens.usage: Max width of running text (about 70 characters at body).

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Grid gutter and page side padding at 768px and up (16px below, space-4).

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of every tap target (Apple HIG).

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Height of the floating NavBar; anchor scroll offset.

tokens.name: rule-width
tokens.usage: Brass hairline thickness.

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: Focus ring stroke and offset.

shadow.note: Borders, not shadows. One shadow, for floating chrome only.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The floating NavBar and its open menu. Nothing else floats.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring for elements where outline is clipped: a 2px ground gap then 2px brass-bright.

tokens.name: z-nav
tokens.usage: Floating NavBar.

tokens.name: z-menu
tokens.usage: Mobile menu sheet under the nav.
